groups.title: New Features
items: Right-click water monitoring: Check Water Temp, Lake/River Level, Dam Flow Info, and Flood Alerts from map context menu using USGS NWIS, NOAA CO-OPS, USACE CWMS, and NWS AHPS APIs
Safety validation: hotel-in-water detection discards POIs with coordinates in lakes/rivers; ramp-near-water verification confirms ramps are within 500m of mapped waterway
Stale data warning banner: persistent amber banner when any enabled district data is older than 30 days
PDF workplan export: formatted multi-page PDF via jsPDF with cover page, per-day schedules with aid details, and summary page
Service worker: cache-first for map tiles, network-first for API calls, stale-while-revalidate for HTML; enables full offline support after first load
Trip templates & calendar: save/reload complete trip configurations with new database tables; multi-trip calendar CRUD endpoints
Spatial index: SpatialGrid class replaces O(n) warm pool linear scan with grid-based O(k) lookup for faster POI searches
Unified config system: AppConfig singleton with lazy-loaded API keys, paths, and version replacing scattered config files
Constants extraction: 80+ magic numbers (cache TTLs, search radii, timeouts, pool sizes) extracted into constants.py

groups.title: Improvements
items: Persistent status toasts: water check "Checking..." toasts stay visible until API responds instead of auto-dismissing after 3 seconds
Expanded water temp search: dedicated USGS param 00010 query with 50mi radius and 24hr lookback; NOAA water level stations (not just tide predictions) for inland coverage
Exception logging: 27 bare pass blocks replaced with log.debug()/log.warning() calls across app.py and database.py
Coordinate validation: unified validate_coords() and parse_lat_lon() helpers replacing 15+ inline variations
Database enhancements: 4 new tables (trip_templates, trip_template_aids, trip_schedule, trip_schedule_aids) with full CRUD

groups.title: Testing
items: 91 pytest tests across 6 test files covering constants, config, cache, utilities, API endpoints, and database CRUD
pytest fixtures with Flask test client and temporary database

groups.title: New Features
items: Water-aware routing: routes automatically follow waterways around land using A* pathfinding on OpenStreetMap water polygons fetched from the Overpass API; works for both the workplan Route Map and the free-form Route Planner
Water station layer toggles: new "Water" dropdown in toolbar lets you show/hide Tides, Currents, USGS Gages, and Dams independently; state persists across sessions
Unit preferences: Settings panel now has a Units tab to switch temperature (F/C), wind speed (kt/mph/kph), elevation (ft/m), and distance (NM/mi/km); applied to NOAA and USGS station popups

USACE CWMS dam data: replaced broken USBR RISE API with USACE Corps Water Management System; dynamically discovers dams across all 24 USACE offices with real-time reservoir elevation, inflow, outflow, and storage
USGS stream gages: viewport-based lazy loading of active USGS gages with discharge, gage height, and water temperature

groups.title: Improvements
items: Two-row centered toolbar: navigation controls on top row, map layers and tools on bottom row; cleaner layout with section labels ("Layers", "Tools") and consistent button sizing

Faster trip generation: Phase 2 hotel refinement skipped when sufficient hotels found in Phase 1; 20-second timeout on corridor search; reduced Overpass search radius; progress bar updates throughout optimization pipeline
OSRM batch timeout: 30-second timeout on driving distance calculations prevents indefinite hangs
Water station visibility: dark circular backgrounds with colored borders for all water markers; tide/dam/USGS markers stacked above current markers for better visibility
ENC charts: restored WMS endpoint after NOAA tile services were discontinued
Preflight speed: removed sequential NAVCEN HEAD requests that caused 45+ second startup hangs

Fixed USGS gage temperature displaying in Celsius regardless of unit preference

Fixed progress step indicators not advancing during optimization pipeline

groups.title: New Features
items: Tides & Water Levels: right-click map to search nearby water stations from NOAA CO-OPS (tides, currents), USGS NWIS (river/stream gages), and USBR RISE (reservoirs like Lake Roosevelt/Grand Coulee)
Clickable station markers: left-click any water station marker to load detailed tide predictions, reservoir elevation/inflow/storage, or gage readings
Route backbone snapping: workplan Route Map follows saved routes along waterways instead of drawing straight lines across land
Auto Route button: one-click to connect all aids for a day, snapping to saved routes if available
Select All in Aids Browser: moved to each tab's "N aids in view" header for better workflow; auto-opens workplan panel after selection

groups.title: New Features
items: Trip workplan generator: smart geographic clustering with sequential waterway partitioning
Route optimization: 2-opt with waterway linear ordering and recovery ramp end-bias
Waterway tortuosity factor: auto-computed from aid GPS positions (accounts for river bends)
Per-aid work time estimation: based on characteristics, RACON, AIS, optics, range, height, and remarks
Full day time budget: launch/recovery prep, ramp transit, approach/departure, work, contingency buffer
Joint ramp optimization: evaluates top 3 launch x top 3 recovery ramps (9 combinations)
Barrier-aware ramp scoring: dams, locks, weirs detected via OpenStreetMap
Tight cluster detection: aids <0.5mi apart never split across days
Hotel recommendations: multi-night preference scoring, lodging subtype classification (hotels, motels, resorts, airport hotels, campgrounds)
Boat ramp finder: surface quality, fee info, smart POI-based naming
Weather forecasts: NWS API with severe weather alerts
